title: Implications for Quality of Life and Quality of Care in Patients With Hereditary Haemochromatosis
brief_summary: Patients with hereditary haemochromatosis will be interviewed/questioned about their Quality of life and the delivered quality of care in the hospital.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* phase 1: experts in the field of haemochromatosis (hepatologists, hematologists, endocrinologists, general practitioner, nurses, ...)
* phase 2: patients with hereditary haemochromatosis, treatment with phlebotomy since 3 months, Dutch/English speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with secondary iron overload
* phlebotomy treatment less than 3 months
* language: no Dutch or English
study_population: Phase 1: RAND-modified Delphi Method: experts in the field of hereditary haemochromatosis Phase 2: Patients with hereditary haemochromatosis
